arStrings.szText: Ceremony was much more important to the first of our Order. (No surprise there; where an angel leads, displays of deference follow.)
Mummification was one such ritual whose instances dwindled along with our numbers.
The Horadrim Cathan performed the task with distaste. It went against her faith. Early Zakarum buried their dead free from the postmortem violations of embalmment.
Nonetheless, I admire the slow and careful dedication with which she carried out the rite.
We Horadrim seek to find answers. To do that, we must remain open to the possibility that the answers we have found might yet be wrong.
